note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 original description of Eutermes Acajutlae (in German); includes the alate, soldier and worker; type locality San Salvador: Acajutla. Two head values of the worker contradict the soldier head width and look like an OCR row shift, so they are not cited. The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Medium to rather large (alate with wings 17 mm, soldier body length 5 mm); the compound eyes of the adult are large and rather prominent, the ocelli are not far from the compound eyes, the frontal marks are short and slit-like, and the sagittal suture is particularly distinct; the soldier head capsule is densely covered with coarse long bristles, the nasus is rather short and conical, and the frontal outline is slightly concave; very close to the pale-headed E. macrocephalus (Silvestri).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, the postclypeus, labrum, mandible bases and antennae rusty yellow, the basal antennal segment darker; thoracic nota rusty yellow, wings greyish yellow, abdominal tergites brown, sternites yellow with brown sides. Head surface rather glossy, bristles not dense; head broadly oval, compound eyes large and rather prominent, the ocelli only slightly farther away. Frontal marks short, slit-like; sagittal suture particularly clear; muscle scars in a transverse line in front of the frontal marks; antennal organ distinct. Postclypeus rather short. Antennae 15-segmented: segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3 and equal to segment 4. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, lateral margins rounded and blunt, posterior margin weakly concave in the middle; mesonotum only slightly concave in the middle, metanotum with a distinct but shallow emargination. Media close to the cubitus, usually forked at its end; cubitus with 5—10 branches, the inner 3—6 coarser. Measurements: body length (with wings) 17 mm; head length 1.94 mm; head width 1.71 mm; from the anterior margin of the transverse band to the occiput 1.15 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, the tip of the nasus paler; antennae yellowish brown to rusty yellow, the rest of the body rusty yellow. Head densely covered with erect coarse long bristles, abdominal plates densely covered with dark erect long hairs. Head very broadly oval to nearly circular, nasus rather short and conical, frontal outline very weakly concave; antennae rather long, 13-segmented: segment 3 almost twice segment 2, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2. Anterior margin of pronotum concave, the anterior lateral lobes only slightly upturned. Measurements: body length 5 mm; head length 1.75—1.90 mm; head width 1.20—1.39 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head densely covered with bristles, abdomen densely covered with dark bristles. Vertex plate brown, the region behind the middle of the transverse band also brown, the rest mostly rusty yellow; body rusty yellow, whitish. Head broadly oval; head capsule sutures fine; frontal marks triangular; postclypeus almost as long as half its width. Antennae 14-segmented: segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 equal to segment 4, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4. Anterior margin of pronotum deeply concave, saddle not strong. Body length 5—5.5 mm (the head measurements are blurred in the OCR and are not cited).
